limitations: Drafts belong to the current browser and origin; clearing site data removes them. Download packages for backup.
Public uploads are square PNG/JPEG, 512–1024px and up to 3 MB.
Automated Chrome file chooser was blocked by extension file-access permission. Hosted upload API verified with synthetic PNG; existing local upload flow had prior browser verification.
Generation processes the source remotely without persistent collection storage. A function instance accepts two simultaneous jobs and returns retryable overload errors.
Canonical assets, renderer, extraction algorithm, registries and releases are unchanged.
